tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer – E-Commerce & Checkout Solutions
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in translating business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specs, managing backlogs in Agile Scrum teams, and driving checkout-related API and data integrations. Proven track record of performance optimisation, cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design and data, and delivering measurable improvements in conversion and reliability.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Product Owner – Checkout
cover_en.hook: I am excited to apply for the Senior Product Owner – Checkout role at Puma because of your commitment to delivering fast, reliable digital experiences that match the energy of sport. With over 5 years of building and optimizing SAP Commerce Cloud checkout flows for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep technical expertise with a strong business-analysis background.

bullets.label: User Stories & Acceptance
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I translated business requirements into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications, ensuring the development team delivered checkout-related features that met stakeholder expectations.

bullets.label: Backlog & Prioritisation
bullets.text: Managed the product backlog for e-commerce enhancements, prioritising items based on impact on conversion and system stability, and continuously refined priorities during sprint planning.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Collaborated daily with engineering, design and data teams to deliver OCC REST APIs and PIM-ERP integrations that streamlined the checkout flow, meeting release deadlines in a global environment.

bullets.label: Performance & KPI Focus
bullets.text: Optimised SQL queries and API performance, reducing latency by 30 % and directly improving checkout conversion metrics, with regular monitoring and reporting to stakeholders.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Puma’s checkout experience.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung: Senior Product Owner – Checkout
cover_de.hook: Ich freue mich, mich für die Position Senior Product Owner – Checkout bei Puma zu bewerben, weil Ihr Fokus auf schnellen, zuverlässigen digitalen Einkaufserlebnissen meine Leidenschaft für sportliche Innovationen widerspiegelt. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Optimierung von SAP Commerce Cloud Checkout-Prozessen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell verbinde ich tiefes technisches Know-how mit starkem Business-Analyse-Background.

bullets.label: User Stories & Akzeptanzkriterien
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Geschäftsanforderungen in detaillierte User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien und funktionale Spezifikationen übersetzt, um Checkout-Features termingerecht zu liefern.

bullets.label: Backlog & Priorisierung
bullets.text: Ich habe den Produkt-Backlog für E-Commerce-Verbesserungen verwaltet, Items nach Einfluss auf Conversion und Systemstabilität priorisiert und während der Sprint-Planung kontinuierlich angepasst.

bullets.label: Cross-funktionale Lieferung
bullets.text: In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Design und Data-Teams habe ich OCC-REST-APIs und PIM-ERP-Integrationen bereitgestellt, die den Checkout-Flow optimierten und globale Release-Termine einhielten.

bullets.label: Performance & KPI-Fokus
bullets.text: Durch Optimierung von SQL-Abfragen und API-Leistung reduzierte ich die Latenz um 30 % und steigerte damit die Checkout-Conversion, mit regelmäßiger Überwachung und Reporting an Stakeholder.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15. Dezember 2026 und kann ab dem 16. Dezember 2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zur Optimierung Ihres Checkout-Erlebnisses zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Puma’s blend of sport heritage and digital ambition creates a unique platform where fast, reliable checkout experiences directly enhance athlete and fan engagement. I am drawn to your commitment to innovation and the opportunity to shape a checkout journey that reflects Puma’s energetic brand while driving conversion and customer satisfaction.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Puma deliver a seamless, high-performance checkout that matches the brand’s sport-driven spirit and boosts conversion rates.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce developer with 5+ years of checkout optimisation experience. I’d love to discuss how I can help Puma enhance its checkout performance. Let’s connect!
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernise Puma’s checkout APIs, integrate PIM-ERP data flows and optimise performance, leveraging my proven SAP Commerce Cloud expertise. My hands-on experience with OCC services, CI/CD pipelines and production support will ensure a smooth, high-availability checkout experience.
tailoring.insight: Your focus on conversion, payment success and reliability aligns with my track record of reducing checkout latency by 30 % and improving transaction success rates through API and database optimisation.
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience optimizing checkout flows for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Puma’s dedication to fast, reliable digital experiences inspires me, and I can boost your checkout conversion through proven API, integration and performance expertise. I have attached my CV and cover letter and look forward to discussing how I can contribute.
